rules.selection: Highest valid native score per task and iteration across extracted runs, source copies, archived retries and repository results. Ties prefer newer dated/master batches, then completionfix, then source path. Invalid/incomplete attempts are excluded. Explicit taskRunOverrides replace only their specified iterations (all nine when omitted), regardless of older scores.
rules.validity: complete=true, valid_for_success_rate=true, finite numeric native_score in [0,1]. Real zeros count; missing/invalid outcomes stay null.
rules.aggregation: Task scores and success rates average available selected native episode scores and explicit boolean native_success, multiplied by 100. Overall score and success rate each use the equal-weight mean of the five RoboDojo dimension metrics defined in data/score-dimensions.json. Each dimension averages its task metrics; Generalization equally averages the standard and randomized split means. Missing episodes are excluded, never zero-filled; calculations use unrounded values.
rules.coverage: Warmup expects 3 episodes per task; RSI expects 6. Repository-only tasks retain their available iter3–5; absent iter6–8 are missing, never repeated or zero-filled.
